question: Should this PR land the direct WebChat Stop recovery using `startedAt` as the same-session run-generation boundary, or should maintainers require a broader session-recovery design first?
rationale: The patch changes persisted session lifecycle terminalization and stale-run rejection; green tests do not decide whether `startedAt` is the intended permanent run-generation owner.

options.title: Land Focused Recovery After Rebase
options.body: Accept `startedAt` ordering for this direct WebChat Stop path and keep compaction/restart-recovery variants separate.

options.title: Broaden Session Recovery
options.body: Require this branch to also cover the compaction/restartRecoveryRuns context-loss report before landing.

options.title: Pause For Unified Invariant
options.body: Hold this PR and design a single stronger run-generation owner across Stop, restart recovery, and compaction races.

recommendation.title: Land Focused Recovery After Rebase
recommendation.body: Accept `startedAt` ordering for this direct WebChat Stop path and keep compaction/restart-recovery variants separate.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned on the PR, left the maintainer review note about the stale-run race, and recently refactored the current WebChat/session lifecycle files.
